hotspots.title: Midterm Campaign Blitz
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump and Vice President J.D. Vance are leading an intensive series of midterm campaign rallies across key states including Oklahoma, Alabama, Ohio, and Florida. Enthusiastic crowds gathered for hours in heavy rain to hear Trump urge voters to treat the midterms as if he were directly on the ballot.
hotspots.affect: The campaign blitz drives maximum affective engagement through populist loyalty, high-stakes midterm urgency, and intense partisan mobilization.

hotspots.title: Immigration Enforcement Legal Battles
hotspots.blurb: Legal controversies surrounding federal immigration policy are intensifying following a federal lawsuit over a fatal ICE shooting in Minneapolis and the Supreme Court agreeing to review mandatory detention policies. Activists are simultaneously preparing for potential immigration enforcement actions near polling places ahead of the elections.
hotspots.affect: Fatal enforcement outcomes and high-stakes constitutional reviews trigger severe moral outrage, fear, and deep political polarization.

hotspots.title: Judicial Rebukes of Executive Power
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges issued significant rulings blocking border wall construction in Big Bend National Park and reinstating a terminated U.S. Attorney, while seven states launched a lawsuit against the administration over impounded federal funds. Additionally, congressional leaders are challenging taxpayer-funded pre-election television spots as unlawful propaganda.
hotspots.affect: A wave of adverse court decisions and multi-state lawsuits creates elevated constitutional drama around presidential overreach.

hotspots.title: Norwegian Fuel‑Tax Protest Coalition
hotspots.blurb: Fremskrittspartiet (FrP) has formed a joint parliamentary front with Sp and KrF demanding immediate fuel tax cuts for the rest of the year. The opposition parties are pressing the government to act as diesel prices surge past record highs of 31 NOK per liter.
hotspots.affect: Surging consumer fuel costs spark sharp economic grievance and aggressive parliamentary challenge against government energy taxation.
